correctness.rationale: For d>=2, A=sum S_i over commuting cube-coordinate involutions gives A^2=(d mod 2)I, and the half-cube block form gives rank(A) or rank(A+I)=m. With removed edge u-v, B=A+uv^T+vu^T; the invariant W=span{u,v,Au,Av} has dimension four and explicit local action Bu=v+Au, Bv=u+Av, B(Au)=(1+delta)u, B(Av)=(1+delta)v. For even d W is an invertible four-dimensional C((X^2+X+1)^2), complement is m-2 J2(0). For odd d the kernel span{Au,Av} is two-dimensional and semisimple; on Im B, ranks (B+I)^2=2, (B+I)^3=1, (B+I)^4=0 force J4(1) plus m-3 J2(1). Fitting decomposition supplies exact periods, fixed-space dimensions, cycle and transient counts for every characteristic-two extension. Independent GF2 bit-matrix checks d=2..7 verified ranks and fixed-space dimensions. Finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.
residual_risks: Only one deleted undirected edge, characteristic two, synchronous linear neighbor sum, d>=2; over extension fields X²+X+1 may split but its rational companion remains valid.
